title: Pay Order to Nauvoo City Treasurer for Elbridge Tufts, 8 January 1844
handwriting: Handwriting of Jonathan Dunham and JS
source_note: JS as Mayor, Pay Order, Nauvoo, Hancock Co., IL, to Nauvoo City Treasurer [William Clayton], for Elbridge Tufts, 8 Jan. 1844; handwriting of Jonathan Dunham and JS; notation in handwriting of William Clayton; one page; private possession; photocopy of recto in Joseph Smith Papers project files.
